method: Existing _doc_code_mentions detector: code/backtick/call-form references to frozen bare API names. Matches do not certify documentation completeness or qualified symbol ownership.

records.style: Benefits and a fluent task example, followed by reference links (Markdown)
records.structure: Release information → what/why → thumbnail workflow → features/examples/API links → license.
records.data: Placeholder directory of images; maximum pixel dimensions, aspect-ratio behavior and JPEG output are explained. The example does not supply an actual fixture directory.

records.style: Scientific overview, domain workflow and documentation navigation (reStructuredText)
records.structure: Simulation-analysis overview → community/governance → example analysis → installation/docs → contribution/citation.
records.example: mda.Universe('topol.tpr', 'traj.trr') → select_atoms('name OH') → positions/velocities/forces → trajectory iteration and center_of_mass().
records.data: Names a topology/trajectory pair using TPR/TRR extensions. These are placeholder files, not the study's checked-in fixture paths; the root example does not fully describe shapes, units or available trajectory fields.
records.strength: Shows the central Universe/AtomGroup/trajectory relationship and a meaningful scientific workflow.
records.barrier: An agent still needs valid paired files, selections and available attributes. The A1 bundle additionally includes local Sphinx sources and a hosted-doc snapshot.
records.check: Audit actual fixture formats, topology/trajectory compatibility and field availability separately from README style. Generated/repair documents remain snapshot evidence while the pipeline runs.

records.style: System-component map and navigation (Markdown; pinned Beast source)
records.structure: System overview → spatial data and IO → visualization → raster/vector processing → synthetic-data generator → installation/developer/data links.
records.example: No executable API workflow in the root README. Usage and setup are delegated to beast/doc.
records.data: Lists spatial formats including Shapefile, CSV, JSON/WKT and GeoJSON; detailed loading and environment instructions are in linked local documents.
records.strength: Explains how the system's capabilities fit together and points to task-specific documentation.
records.barrier: A root-only reader lacks executable receiver/data setup. The historical documented-88 cohort refers to the full original bundle, not this README alone.
records.check: Keep historical 171-entry results separate from the new validated 161-API study. The reused generated file has 171 entry headings; its 10 extra entries are outside the new experiment manifest. New v5 has no scheduled A1 rerun; its original documentation is inspected as context.
